description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8 with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30 with tick marks at integer values. There are four lines displayed on the plot. The first line is purple with circular markers and a dashed line style; it starts at approximately (1, 22) and increases to approximately (8, 28.4). The second line is blue with square markers and a dashed line style; it begins at approximately (1, 22.2) and rises to approximately (8, 28.2). The third line is dark blue with square markers and a dashed line style; it starts at approximately (1, 24.7) and increases to approximately (8, 29.1). The fourth line is red with star-shaped markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (1, 24.6) and increases to approximately (8, 29.6).
